about: The evangelium of the formulary “Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit, and she exclaimed in a loud voice and said: Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb. And how has this fallen to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me? For behold, as soon as the voice of your greeting sounded in my ears, the infant in my womb leaped with joy. And blessed are you who have believed, because the things that were spoken to you by the Lord will be fulfilled. And Mary said: My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior, for He has regarded the lowliness of His handmaid; behold, from now on all generations will call me blessed. For He who is mighty has done great things for me, and holy is His name, and His mercy is from generation to generation for those who fear Him.
